column1: # One row per line, tab separated, `#` starts a comment. These are words where
# the Avro rule table and the licensed WTR1 aliases both produce a different
# form than the everyday spelling, so the engine would otherwise offer the rule
# output first (for example `chokh` -> ছখ instead of চোখ).
# This is a deliberately small overlay, not a dictionary: it is staged with the
# curated score (1.30) and must stay limited to words with an identified gap.
# A future index rebuild folds these rows into the curated section; until then
# this file is the single review surface for them. Everything here is our own
# spelling data, so it carries no licensing obligation.
